compiled_state.title: [two-tier llm-review]: PR2 llm-review re-reviews FP-recovered content -> second admin override per FP-recovery
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* code_version: 3c632aa59c64b2c0b545bff37e716f924f554b2c
* Observed landing DD4 (3ebb) through the two-tier flow: PR1 #633 (source->staged), PR2 #634 (staged->main).

### 2. Incident Overview
* Scenario Type: Sub-Agent Blocker (autonomous dogfood discovery)

#### Expected Behavior
When PR1's review (review-sub-pr) is FP-recovered (admin override after a clean opus review), PR2 (staged->main) should NOT require a SECOND override. The override should propagate so PR2's required review check passes. DD4 (override-propagation) wires the admin-exemption LEDGER so the COVERAGE-invariant treats FP-recovered SHAs as reviewed-equivalent.

#### Actual Behavior
PR2 #634's required `llm-review` check ran a FULL content review (NOT a provenance-skip) and re-surfaced the SAME FP-amplified findings, FAILING -> requiring a SECOND admin override. Notably PR2 #632 (29e7) llm-review SKIPPED, but #634's ran full. DD4 propagates COVERAGE (per-SHA reviewed-equivalent via the ledger) but does NOT address PR2's llm-review CONTENT re-review. So an FP-recovered change needs TWO overrides (review-sub-pr on PR1 + llm-review on PR2), defeating the single-override goal. ROOT-CAUSE UNVERIFIED: why does PR2 llm-review provenance-skip for some PRs (#632) but re-review for others (#634)? Investigate llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh / the provenance-skip condition. May require extending override-propagation (DD4) to make PR2's llm-review honor the admin-exemption ledger / the FP-recovery clearance, OR the coverage-based skip. PLAN-RELEVANT: affects the enforce-flip friction model + the single-override objective. Relates to epic 588e / 3ebb DD4 / 3ee4.

comments.body: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (2026-06-04): the override-propagation has TWO consumers, DD4 only wired ONE. (1) review-coverage-invariant.sh consults ael_sha_is_exempt (DD4 — 3 refs) -> FP-recovered SHAs are coverage-exempt. (2) verify-session-provenance.sh drives the llm-review DISPATCH (llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh: unprovenanced-shas non-empty -> dispatch full review) and does NOT consult the ledger (0 ael refs). v4 removed the DSO-Story trailer self-attestation, so provenance = 'linked to a GitHub PR that passed review'. #633's review-sub-pr FAILED (FP-recovered, merged via override), so its commits are UNPROVENANCED -> #634's llm-review dispatched a full re-review -> re-found the same FPs -> 2nd override. (My DD4 commits also lacked DSO-Story trailers, but v4 ignores trailers anyway; the operative cause is the failed-review linked PR.) FIX DIRECTION: extend override-propagation (DD4 unit 5) to make verify-session-provenance treat an HMAC-VALID admin-exemption-ledger SHA as provenanced (mirror the coverage-invariant wiring) — so PR2's llm-review provenance-SKIPS an FP-recovered commit. SECURITY: same trust model as DD4's coverage exemption (HMAC-signed by .closure-key + opus-gated FP-recovery), so no new laundering path. Pending panel review.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: PANEL VERDICT (2026-06-04): accuracy=ACCURATE (gap+root-cause confirmed), fitness=delivers single-override, security=SOUND-WITH-CONDITIONS. Fix = 3ebb DD4 unit 5 (wire ael_sha_is_exempt into verify-session-provenance, additive/fail-closed, before the covering-PR lookup). SHOWSTOPPER the panel surfaced: the opus-gate is procedural-only — fp-recovery-record-exemption.sh trusts --reviewer-hash without verifying it against a real reviewer-findings.json, and the closure-key is agent-reachable, so honoring the ledger in PROVENANCE (which decides whether the LLM runs) could let an agent self-launder un-reviewed code (the v4 trailer hole, signed). MUST code-enforce the opus-gate (C1) + scope to exempt_by=fp-recovery (C2) + establish the key boundary (C3) BEFORE wiring provenance or provisioning the key to CI. Full conditions on 3ebb (DD4 unit 5) + 3ee4 (P8c).

Provenance log confirms all 4 REAL code commits (bc704f53e6/c5a1ad3905/8b4a3d2306/6ed7367069) resolved 'covering-PR #668 merged-by-bypass-actor=207596960 (reviewed-equivalent)' — identity exemption worked for code; the merge-commit-empty-diff class still trips fail-closed. Same content was opus-FP-recovery-cleared on #668 (reviewer hash ed5b6a41ef25bd15...). Root: ci-pr two-tier flow still produces merge commits (cca8 linear-history DD1 explicitly deferred the STORY_PR_BASE/ci-pr path). All other #671 required checks green.

comments.body: REVISED FIX DIRECTION (588e panel): drop the HMAC-ledger DD4-unit-5 approach (MOOTED by ADR-0022 identity exemption; cf SUPERSEDED 2730). comments.body: INVESTIGATION COMPLETE (INTERMEDIATE, opus). Root cause confirmed + panel direction grounded. Safety crux EMPIRICALLY PINNED: git diff-tree --cc <sha> with exit-code-separate-from-emptiness distinguishes genuinely-empty-net (rc0+0files: real 84da55a83c, clean octopus) EXEMPT vs content/conflict/evil/single-parent (rc0+nonempty) NOT-exempt vs uncomputable (rc128) ERROR/fail-closed. FIX: new shared predicate rc_diff_is_empty_net in review-coverage-lib.sh [EXEMPT iff >=2 parents AND diff-tree --cc rc==0 AND empty file list; rc1 non-merge/non-empty; rc2 ERROR on diff-tree!=0 -> callers fail closed]. Wire additively+fail-closed into the 3 DD6 shared-predicate consumers (review-coverage-invariant.sh ~149, verify-session-provenance.sh ~419, fp-recovery-audit-sweep.sh) BEFORE the existing unprovenanced/UNREVIEWED fail-close; dispatcher (llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh:493-507) inherits transitively via verify-session-provenance's unprovenanced-shas.txt (NOT a shared-predicate consumer, no edit). Extend DD6 equivalence test + negative controls (content merge, single-parent, octopus-with-content, bad-sha). Built ON the shared lib (one predicate / consumers), NOT parallel, NOT content-hash carry-forward. Classification behavioral score 5 INTERMEDIATE; testing_mode RED. Safeguard edit proceeding under user directive 'complete the remaining major fix' + panel-approved direction.
